subject: Next steps: buying map, security intake & systems in-scope for Silverline POC
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@silverlinehealth.com>, Tom Breuer <tom.breuer@silverlinehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: buying map, security intake & systems in-scope for Silverline POC

Thanks again for taking time this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same buying map and scope for the security intake.

Recap (what we heard)
- Economic buyer: Tom Breuer (CFO) — procurement/contract sign-off.
- Primary technical contact: Amelia Ross (Head of Engineering) — will own systems/infra details.
- Procurement contact: procurement@silverlinehealth.com (please confirm name).
- Decision criteria called out on the call: performance (95th <= 300ms for interactive flows), data residency in us-east, and clear audit logs / SLA for availability.

Suggested systems in-scope for initial review (please confirm or edit)
1) Patient web portal (portal.silverlinehealth.com) — UI flows, logged-in auth, PII in prompts.
2) Backend API (azure-prod - App Service + Postgres) — inference calls initiated server-side.
3) SFTP batch interface (claims integration) — files with claims metadata.
4) Internal admin tools (admin.silverlinehealth.com) — lower volume, admin-facing features.

Requested next steps
- Please review and confirm the systems above (or add any we missed).
- Please complete the attached initial security questionnaire and return with any redlines: [Attachment: Silverline_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)].
- If acceptable, propose a 30-minute security intake (engineering + security + procurement) next week — Diego/Mina can host.

I'll also loop in our security lead (Mina) to follow up on technical details and to request any network diagrams or dataflow docs.

Thanks — looking forward to the POC.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Silverline_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf]

From: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@silverlinehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Breuer <tom.breuer@silverlinehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@silverlinehealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: buying map, security intake & systems in-scope for Silverline POC

Thanks Diego — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Decision criteria: to add clarity for your team, our internal scoring rubric prioritizes (1) data residency + encryption, (2) performance (95th under ~300ms for interactive patient queries), (3) clear data processing agreement and SOC2 evidence, and (4) ability to run in our VPC or private deployment.
- We do expect that some prompts will include limited PHI (patient initials, appointment dates) — we will scope exact fields in the questionnaire.
- Procurement contact is Janet Atkinson (janet.atkinson@silverlinehealth.com) — procurement@ is a shared mailbox.

I've attached a lightly redlined version of the questionnaire with a few follow-up Qs on retention and audit logs. We'll aim to have procurement join the intake call.

Proposed intake windows: Tue 24 Jun (9–11am PT) or Thu 26 Jun (1–4pm PT).

Appreciate Mina joining the intake.

Regards,
Amelia Ross
Head of Engineering, Silverline Health
amelia.ross@silverlinehealth.com
[Attachment: Silverline_Response_Redline.docx]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: buying map, security intake & systems in-scope for Silverline POC

Diego / Ben — quick internal follow-up after Amelia's redline. I can take point on the intake and technical questionnaire. A few items we should collect before the intake call so the session is focused:

- Data types / sample fields: confirm whether full PHI is present or limited fields (we need a minimal sample schema).
- Expected QPS and concurrency (approximate peak for portal interactive flows).
- Network layout: public endpoints, private subnets, egress IPs, and if there is a VPC peering requirement.
- Retention requirements: how long prompt/response logs must be retained, and whether they should be purged after X days.
- Auth model: server-side tokens vs client-initiated calls (affects caching and KV strategies).
- Audit & logging: which teams need access to token-level logs and S3/Blob retention policies.

I'll prepare an internal checklist and an abbreviated intake worksheet to send to Silverline before the call. Tentative owner on our side: Mina Haddad (Security Lead).

If procurement wants to see SOC2 / DPA templates before the call, I can share our standard pack.

-Mina
Mina Haddad
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@silverlinehealth.com>, Tom Breuer <tom.breuer@silverlinehealth.com>, Janet Atkinson <janet.atkinson@silverlinehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: intake prep and working list of artifacts / dates

Thanks all — summary & agreed next steps: please reply with any edits.

1) Systems in-scope (confirmed unless you push back): portal.silverlinehealth.com, azure-prod API, SFTP batch interface, admin tools.
2) Intake artifacts requested from Silverline (please upload to the shared drive link below prior to the call):
   - Network diagram & hosting region(s)
   - Minimal data schema / sample (redacted) showing PII/PHI fields
   - Expected QPS / typical concurrency numbers
   - Retention policy for prompt/response logs
   - Contact for procurement (Janet Atkinson) to handle DPA/contract redlines

3) Tentative intake slots from Silverline: Tue 24 Jun 9:00–9:30 PT (preferred) or Thu 26 Jun 1:30–2:00 PT. Please confirm one.
4) Redwood will share: SOC2 evidence pack, standard DPA template, and an abbreviated intake worksheet (I'll upload to the Drive).

Drive + prep folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEF_sample_drive_link
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/SL-9053

Attachments we sent/received: Silverline_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf, Silverline_Response_Redline.docx

If everyone is good, I'll schedule the 30-minute intake and invite the suggested attendees (Amelia, Janet/procurement, Tom for economics, Mina + 1 infra engineer, Ben for contracts).

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
